mapper.select: SELECT id, doctor_name, department, title, phone, email, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM dbo.doctor ORDER BY id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT id, doctor_name, department, title, phone, email, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM dbo.doctor WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dbo.doctor(doctor_name, department, title, phone, email) VALUES(#{doctorName}, #{department}, #{title}, #{phone}, #{email})
mapper.update: UPDATE dbo.doctor SET doctor_name=#{doctorName}, department=#{department}, title=#{title}, phone=#{phone}, email=#{email}, updated_at=SYSDATETIME() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dbo.doctor SET deleted=1, updated_at=SYSDATETIME() WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dbo.doctor WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT title AS name, title, COUNT(1) AS value, COUNT(1) AS count FROM dbo.doctor WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY title ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC
SELECT department AS name, department, COUNT(1) AS value, COUNT(1) AS count FROM dbo.doctor WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY department ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC
